quick_skim.title: FGD2HF: Frequency-guided Dual-domain Hypergraph Fusion for Semantic Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Frequency-domain information is beneficial for semantic segmentation. However, existing frequency-based methods often suffer from insufficient frequency utilization, inefficient fusion, and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FGD2HF, a dual-domain fusion network that leverages frequency features to guide spatial-domain fusion and enhancement. Specifically, we introduce a novel Hybrid-Attention Encoder (NAHA) that jointly models local and global relationships through neighborhood and hypergraph attention, enhancing the network's ability to extract effective features. We further introduce a Wavelet Transform and Enhancement (WTE) module to extract and refine low- and high-frequency cues from preceding-stage features, followed by Frequency-guided Dual-domain Fusion (FGDF) modules that use frequency cues to condition current-stage spatial grouping and feature propagation. This design incorporates both global and local frequency guidance into spatial feature modulation, enhancement and fusion with low computational cost. Extensive comparisons with numerous state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods demonstrate that our method is highly competitive. Our full FGD2HF-B model achieves 48.7% mIoU on ADE20K (+0.3% over SegMAN-B with 18% fewer GFLOPs), 83.2% mIoU on Cityscapes (comparable to SegMAN-B with 21% fewer GFLOPs), and 1.1% higher mIoU than VWFormer-T on SBD with 21% fewer GFLOPs, while also achieving significant improvements in boundary segmentation accuracy.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: To address insufficient frequency use and costly fusion in frequency-based segmentation, FGD2HF proposes a dual-domain network with hybrid-attention encoding and wavelet enhancement, improving semantic segmentation accuracy while reducing complexity.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对现有频域语义分割方法频率利用不足、融合低效且计算复杂的问题，本文提出频域引导的双域超图融合网络FGD2HF。方法设计混合注意力编码器联合建模局部与全局关系，并用波let变换增强模块提取高低频线索引导空间域融合。实验表明该网络在语义分割任务上提升了精度并降低计算开销。该工作说明频域与空间域协同融合是增强分割特征的有效途径。

quick_skim.title: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: open-vocabulary instance segmentation adapted to underwater scenes

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Introduces GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning method for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation that stabilizes vision-language alignment under color attenuation, scattering and low contrast.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 开放词汇实例分割依赖视觉区域特征与文本类别嵌入的对齐，但在水下环境中色衰减、散射与低对比度会使该假设失效。本文提出GeoPrompt，引入几何条件化的提示学习来校正退化视觉特征与语义概念之间的匹配关系。实验表明该方法在水下场景中对已见与未见类别的分割精度均有提升。其意义在于把几何先验引入提示学习，增强了开放词汇分割在恶劣成像条件下的鲁棒性。

quick_skim.title: LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM
quick_skim.abstract: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: frozen streaming 3D foundation model acts as depth estimator from monocular video

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Presents LingGS, an online monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM system that uses a frozen streaming 3D foundation model as a virtual RGB-D sensor and decouples feed-forward geometry prediction from explicit camera tracking.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 在有限优化预算下，单目RGB高斯泼溅SLAM难以同时保证高质量重建与响应式相机跟踪。本文将前馈几何预测与显式几何跟踪解耦，用冻结的流式三维基础模型充当虚拟RGB-D传感器提供单目深度，再由显式几何求解器通过特征重投影估计相机运动。实验表明该组合的跟踪精度显著优于学习式相机预测，并保持稠密场景重建质量。该工作展示了深度基础模型作为几何先验在在线SLAM中的实用价值。
